statusPanelIntro: System health report modeled after the admin status table, using backend-friendly keys for both PHP and NodeJS deployments.
skeletonsPanelIntro: Enable or disable site skeletons discovered from the skeleton listing endpoint.
themesPanelIntro: Enable or disable installable themes discovered from the theme listing source.
blocksPanelIntro: Manage allowed blocks using the same grouped checkbox experience as allowed-blocks UI.
integrationsPanelIntro: Configure API credentials and integration defaults used by media and automation features.
apiKeysSectionDescription: Manage provider API keys used for media and AI integrations. Keys are stored server-side in _config/apiKeys.json.
mediaPanelIntro: Set image quality, upload constraints, and transformation behavior defaults.
mediaPolicySectionDescription: Media policy values are stored in system-level media settings.
configurationPanelIntro: Set the default language applied to newly created sites and other system-wide configuration defaults.
localizationSectionDescription: Localization defaults are stored in the system config localization block.
styleGuidePanelIntro: Style guide controls are intentionally disabled while backend support is finalized.
customCodePanelIntro: Edit global CSS and JavaScript. Empty values are valid and will save as empty.
schemaEndpointUnavailable: Schema file operation endpoint is unavailable.
savedApiKeysLoadFailed: Saved API keys could not be loaded right now.
apiKeySettingsSaveFailed: API key settings could not be saved.
savedMediaSettingsLoadFailed: Saved media settings could not be loaded right now.
savedLocalizationSettingsLoadFailed: Saved localization settings could not be loaded right now.
haxcmsVersionDescription: Compare installed HAXcms version with latest available release.
systemSettingsDescription: System-level controls for runtime status, skeletons, themes, allowed blocks, integrations, media defaults, configuration defaults, and global custom code.
dragDropSkeleton: Drag and drop a skeleton JSON file to add it to user skeletons.
uploadEndpointUnavailable: Upload endpoint unavailable for this backend.
skeletonNameNeedsAlphanumeric: Skeleton name must include letters or numbers.
deleteSkeletonConfirm: Delete skeleton "{machineName}"? This cannot be undone.
styleGuideDisabledRelease: Style guide controls are intentionally disabled in this release while backend integration is completed.
noSettingsForPanel: No settings available for this panel yet.
